title: Erasing your data or deleting your account leaves the watch's copy behind
what: The watch keeps its own small store: the last workout's name, the gym's colour, and a screen diary of about two workouts with the time of every screen event and whether a workout was open, so it shows when the member trained. Nothing on the phone or the watch ever clears it: 'Erase all data' and 'Delete my account' on the phone send the watch nothing, and the watch has no erase of its own. It goes only when the watch app is removed. The privacy notice does not mention the watch in its delete steps.
expected: Erasing data or deleting the account also clears what the watch app holds (or the delete steps say to remove the watch app too).
who: members with the watch app who erase their data or delete their account
fix_line: Have the phone's erase and account delete send the watch a clear message that wipes its stored workout and diary, or add 'remove the watch app' to the delete steps.

items.reason: the items list gives 0 promises for this area

Consent: heart rate is asked on its own screen with a reason before the sensor is used, and Not now is offered. Purpose: heart rate is only shown on screen. Notice: the privacy notice covers the watch app and says heart rate is not saved or sent, which the code keeps; the screen-log caption understates what the diary holds (workout open per line), already written as FN-A5-phone-lib-core-3-01. Deletion: the watch is never cleared on erase (finding 01). Breach timing and children: the watch holds no screen, step or record for either.
the watch app has no MettleUp staff access and no server; its screen diary reaches MettleUp only through the phone's Help and feedback switch, which is outside this area

Heart rate lives only in screen memory and is dropped when the screen dims or stops. The diary is a rolling 150 lines (about two workouts) kept on the watch; the notice's 1-year limit is for the server copy. But it and the last workout's name are never cleared by erase or account delete (finding 01).

The watch app makes no internet call: its only outward paths are Google Play services Data Layer items and messages to the paired phone (diary, app version, set Done taps). Heart rate comes from the watch's own Health Services sensor and is never put in any item or message, as the notice says. No AI, WhatsApp, analytics or Health Connect in this area. The diary is copied to the phone on every screen stop even with the screen-log switch off, but it stays on the member's devices until the switch is on (phone side).

No path clears the watch: the watch listens for no erase message and the phone code never deletes its Data Layer items (no deleteDataItems call in the phone's Android code). Backups: the watch holds no server copy.
